ngaap.guidance: 2025 guidance initiated 30-Jan-2025: Revenue $21.8B - $22.2B; adjusted segment operating margin mid - high 15%; by segment: SAS $6.9B - $7.1B, low 12%; IMS $7.0B - $7.2B, low 12%; CS $5.6B - $5.7B, high 24%; AR ~$2.5B, mid 12%. Non-GAAP diluted EPS (prior definition) $13.70 - $14.00 (2024 actual $13.10); intangible amortization, net of income taxes ~(3.15) (2024 (3.40)); Non-GAAP diluted EPS (new definition, excluding the amortization add-back) $10.55 - $10.85 (2024 actual $9.70), growth 10% at mid-point (2024 5%). Adjusted free cash flow $2.4B - $2.5B (2024 $2.3B). Other: FAS/CAS operating adjustment ~$15M (2024 $28M); non-service FAS pension income ~$260M (2024 $322M; includes the reduction from the anticipated transfer of ~$1.2B of pension assets and liabilities to a third party in Q1 2025); net interest expense ~$630M (2024 $675M); effective tax rate on non-GAAP income (new) 11.0% - 12.0% (2024 GAAP rate 5.3%); average diluted shares ~190M (2024 190.7M); capital expenditures ~2% of sales. Guidance assumes a Continuing Resolution through March 2025. LHX NeXt: $800M of cost savings achieved in 2024; overall cost-savings goal raised to $1.2B by the end of 2025, a year ahead of schedule.
ngaap.notes: Adjusted segment operating income/margin = operating income excluding the FAS/CAS operating adjustment, unallocated corporate department expense and the significant / non-recurring items (amortization of acquisition-related intangibles and inventory step-up, merger / acquisition / divestiture-related expenses, divestiture losses and impairments, LHX NeXt implementation costs); in 2024 it equals the sum of segment operating income except where a segment-level impairment is added back (Q4-24 / FY24: $24M at CS). Non-GAAP EPS (2024 basis) = diluted EPS + amortization of acquisition-related intangibles (and inventory step-up) + merger, acquisition and divestiture-related expenses + business divestiture-related losses / impairment of goodwill and other assets + LHX NeXt implementation costs, less income taxes on the adjustments (and NCI portion). Effective tax rate on non-GAAP income = (income taxes + tax on the same items) / (income before income taxes + the items). Adjusted free cash flow = net cash from operating activities - additions to PP&E (net of proceeds from sale of PP&E where shown) + cash used for merger, acquisition and severance (severance included from 2024; prior-year comparatives reclassified). Organic revenue excludes completed divestitures and first-year acquisition revenue (Aerojet Rocketdyne until 28-Jul-2024). Segment adjusted operating income by segment (Table 6): CS 326 + 24 impairment of other assets (Tactical Data Links) = 350; others unadjusted. The Q4-24 release announces that from Q1-25 non-GAAP diluted EPS will exclude the amortization add-back; on the new basis Q4-24 = $2.60 (Q4-25 release comparative: removes $1.11 amortization and $0.23 related tax) and pension adjusted $2.17. The fourth-quarter free cash flow bridge is recorded (release Table 9 quarter column).
